frozen_scope.boundary_budget: For every module, union of incident shared variables has cardinality <= floor(log2(max(2,L))).

candidate_rule.canonical_cut: Choose the lexicographically smallest interaction edge belonging to the unique cycle.
candidate_rule.cut_separator: S = shared variables on the canonical cut edge.
candidate_rule.outer_state: Enumerate every Boolean assignment sigma in {0,1}^S exactly.
candidate_rule.tree_reduction: Remove only the canonical cut edge from the interaction graph; keep sigma fixed consistently in both endpoint modules.
candidate_rule.inner_solver: Run exact typed-module tree dynamic programming on the resulting tree, with sigma injected into local endpoint boundary conditions.
candidate_rule.sat_rule: SAT iff at least one sigma produces a certified tree solution; reconstruct and replay a root witness.
candidate_rule.unsat_rule: UNSAT iff every sigma is independently rejected by the exact conditioned tree computation.
fail_closed: module boundary exceeds frozen logarithmic budget
typed mosaic does not exactly recompose source

complexity_obligation.forbidden_argument: No empirical timing or finite trend may substitute for the symbolic bound.

frozen_tests.positive_cycle_product: All 256 sign orientations of topology [(1,3,4),(1,2,5),(2,3)] must terminate with exact COMMIT_SAT or COMMIT_UNSAT, verified independently against exhaustive truth only as a finite checker oracle.
frozen_tests.negative_multicycle: Two disjoint shifted copies of a frozen OPEN cycle must fail closed; no unicyclic admission.
frozen_tests.negative_width: Frozen wide-center cases that exceed the logarithmic module-boundary budget must remain OPEN_INTERFACE_WIDTH.
frozen_tests.regression: Existing v1.0 known-door checks must remain exact and tamper/root-hash guards unchanged.

pass_condition: All proof-obligation checks encoded by an independent checker pass, all 256 frozen cycle orientations are exact, negative controls fail closed as preregistered, symbolic polynomial ledger is satisfied, and root replay succeeds.
